name: @bba/shared
description: Shared TypeScript types and utilities used by @bba/webapp and @bba/functions

scripts.clean: rm -rf dist tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && find src -name '*.js' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -delete && find src -name '*.js.map' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -delete && find src -name '*.d.ts' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -delete
